title: Reversible web shorthand card
goal: manages the current card and the current two states, allowing the buttons to update the visible content synchronously.
summary: Each card first displays a basic web page question. Turn over to check the answer and return to the question side when moving on to the next page.
tasks: Add aria-controls="card-answer" to #flip-card in index.html to associate the answers it controls.
sets the minimum height of .study-card in style.css to 108px, and the short answer also has a stable card area.
Switch answerSide when #flip-card is clicked and call renderCard to refresh the same card.
Switch to the next card when clicking #next-card, and return to the first card after the last card. Each time you change the card, the question will be displayed first.

example.note: photo is played to the last subscript, the remainder is taken by the array length, and returns to subscript 0 next time.

hint: When changing cards, cardIndex and answerSide need to be updated at the same time. Changing only the subscript will cause the next page to inherit the answer page status of the previous page.
